commonStyle: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D survivor city game art. Detailed hand-painted 2D illustrated environment, dark fine ink outlines, painterly tactile worn materials, believable inhabitable post-apocalyptic survivor camp, muted teal corrugated metal roofs, warm ochre wood, olive greenery, small gold/brass industrial accents. Coherent high oblique camera looking down ~55 degrees with southeast-facing fronts visible. Warm sunlight from upper left, soft cast shadows toward lower right. Not photographic, not clay 3D, no UI, no text, no labels, no symbols, no watermark.

assets.prompt: Create ONE portrait 1024x1536 opaque full-scene ground terrain background for overlaying clickable buildings. Gated survivor courtyard enclosed by low weathered fencing and trees tightly at EXTREME outermost edges. A small noninteractive headquarters building far away centered at the very top, occupying only the top 15 percent. Broad open flat sandy stone paving covers the middle 80 percent of the image with sparse subtle small cracks, moss, pebbles and warm varied paving texture. Keep especially left x28% y42% and right x73% y65% empty for later building placement, and keep generous space around those coordinates empty too. No workshops, factories or large objects in the central 80%. Leaves and small peripheral survivor props only at extreme edges. An open gate at bottom edge leads inward. Rich grounded hand-painted detail and coherent environment, with calm evenly lit central ground. Do not draw any UI or building placement markings.

assets.prompt: Create ONE true transparent PNG building sprite atlas, landscape 1536x1024 or larger exact 3:2 aspect ratio. EXACTLY six isolated lumber/material workshop upgrade buildings arranged in a precise 3 columns by 2 rows grid of equal square cells. Each sprite wholly inside its own cell centered with generous transparent padding/gutters at least 40 pixels on all sides; no overlap or bleeding between cells. Same overall ground footprint scale, same camera and lighting across all six sprites, independently usable on sandy courtyard ground. Row-major sequence: top-left small square construction foundation with partly framed beams, plank bundles, hand tools; top-middle simple wooden shed level1 with modest teal roof and lumber stacks; top-right larger plank workshop level2 with teal metal roof, sawbench and neatly stacked timber; bottom-left brick-and-timber workshop level3-4 with wider distinct silhouette, rooftop vent, machinery and logs; bottom-middle reinforced metal sawmill level5-7, industrial saw machinery, crane arm, teal corrugated roofs and wood storage; bottom-right elaborate fortified lumber production level8-10, robust tall workshop complex with layered teal roofs, golden metal reinforcement details, mechanical saw line and orderly lumber stock. Visually distinct escalating architecture, no giant resource icons or decorative oversized wood symbols. Soft semitransparent ground-contact shadow under each building; absolutely NO backdrop or solid ground tile, no opaque rectangular panels, no checkerboard painted into image. Entire unused canvas and gaps must be actual alpha transparent. No text, no numbers, no grid lines.
